# Comfortaa

`app/src/main/res/font/comfortaa_bold.ttf` is the Bold (wght 700) instance of
[Comfortaa](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/comfortaa) (`Comfortaa[wght].ttf` from
google/fonts), made with fontTools `varLib.instancer`. It sets the page titles in the style of the
Fčil wordmark. Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`).
